markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1], two-model agreement, and zero invasive risk score place this biopsy in routine tier 4.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0%, Normal 0% | All weight on Benign |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (alpha 10%) | Single class at 90% dataset coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% / 70th percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Typical image quality, unflagged input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Two independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Benign (80%) [F5] | One Invasive neighbor at 85% similarity |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.75, contribution -1.16) strongly pushes away from invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 6, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.21, contribution -0.82) favors duct-confined lesion over invasion [F3] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · Below-typical score (-0.12); descriptive only despite +0.60 model weight [F4] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · High text score (+1.55, contribution -0.59) supports preserved tubular architecture · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 0, 3, 10) · context · 62% neoplastic nuclei (93rd percentile) [F7] with 95th-percentile size variation [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing 3 top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); normal lobules and mitoses (both 0/20 AI-checked) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- High neoplastic fraction (62%) and duct-confined score (+1.21) reflect in situ or tubular neoplasia rather than benign epithelium.
- The lesion resembles invasive neighbor BACH_0138 (85% similarity), separated mainly by invasion and unreliable mitoses (0/20).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 6, 7, 8**: Highest tile risk (0.001 to 0.005) and duct-confined scores; exclude in situ carcinoma.
2. **Regions 0, 3, 10**: 111, 41, and 32 neoplastic-called nuclei despite 32 µm² mean area [F8]; confirm benignity.
3. **Regions 1, 9, 10**: Strongest tubule scores and lowest invasion score (region 9); confirm intact benign glands.
